The '''Mudsnout tribe''' is a [[tribe]] of [[gnolls]] found in the [[Hillsbrad Foothills]]. They have overrun [[Nethander Stead]] and are apparently growing large white mushrooms called [[Mudsnout Blossoms]]. They are the only tribe of gnolls, besides the [[Rot Hide]], found in [[Lordaeron]] in ''World of Warcraft''.

==Classes==
There seems to be two [[class]] of Mudsnouts in ''World of Warcraft''.

*Mudsnout Gnoll
*[[Mudsnout Shaman]]

==Famous/Named Mobs==
[[Ro'Bark]] is a level 28 rare spawn, and may be their leader.
